fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Used in links. Leave it empty to generate it from the name.

validation.nameTooLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.
validation.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes, for example "summer-shirts".
validation.slugTooLong: Keep the slug to 140 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description to 2,000 characters or fewer.
validation.logoType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
validation.logoTooLarge: Choose an image of 1 MB or less.
validation.attributeNameTooLong: Keep the name to 60 characters or fewer.
validation.valueNameTooLong: Keep the value to 60 characters or fewer.
validation.codeTooLong: Keep the code to 20 characters or fewer.
validation.codeFormat: Use capital letters, digits and single dashes, for example "RED" or "TSHIRT-RED-M".
validation.tooManyValues: An Attribute can have at most 100 values.
validation.valueRepeated: Each value needs its own name and code.
validation.productNameTooLong: Keep the name to 160 characters or fewer.
validation.productDescriptionTooLong: Keep the description to 5,000 characters or fewer.
validation.priceFormat: Enter an amount like 19.90 (up to two decimals).
validation.costFormat: Enter an amount like 8.25 (up to four decimals).
validation.thresholdFormat: Enter a whole number, or leave it empty for the store default.
validation.tagTooLong: Keep each tag to 40 characters or fewer.
validation.seoTitleTooLong: Keep the SEO title to 70 characters or fewer.
validation.seoDescriptionTooLong: Keep the SEO description to 160 characters or fewer.
validation.skuTooLong: Keep the SKU to 64 characters or fewer.
validation.skuRepeated: Each Variant needs its own SKU.
validation.imageType: Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP images.
validation.imageTooLarge: Choose images of 2 MB or less.

attributes.description: The shared dimensions Variants differ by, such as Size, Color and Material.
attributes.formDescription: Each value needs a code; generated SKUs are made of these codes.
attributes.deleteDescription: The Attribute and its values are removed for good. Attributes used by Variants can't be deleted.
attributes.valuesHint: In display order. A value used by Variants can be renamed but not removed.
attributes.noValues: No values yet. Add the first one.
attributes.emptyDescription: Add Size, Color or Material to generate Variants from them.
attributes.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Attributes appear here once an Operations User adds them.

products.description: Everything the store sells, each Product with its Variants, prices and images.
products.emptyDescription: Create the first Product, then generate its Variants.
products.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Products appear here once an Operations User adds them.
products.selectAll: Select every Product on this page
products.bulkDeleteDescription: The Products and their Variants are removed for good. Products on Orders are skipped; archive them instead.
products.bulkNothingChanged: Those Products already had that status.
products.deleteDescription: The Product, its Variants and its images are removed for good. A Product on Orders can only be archived.
products.newDescription: Describe the Product first; images and Variants come next.
products.editDescription: Details, images and Variants of this Product.
products.seoHint: How the Product appears in search results.
products.basePriceHint: Without VAT. New Variants start at this price.
products.taxableHint: The store's VAT rate applies to this Product.
products.created: Product created. Now add its images and Variants.
products.readOnly: Your Role can look at Products but not change them.

images.title: Images
images.description: The first image is the main image. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB each, 10 at most.
images.emptyDescription: Add a few photos; the first one is shown in lists.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Each Variant has its own SKU, price, Average cost and Low-stock threshold.
variants.builderDescription: Pick values; every combination becomes a Variant. Existing Variants and their data are kept.
variants.lockedAttributes: This Product's Variants differ by {{attributes}}, so only values of these Attributes can be added.
variants.simpleProduct: No Attributes chosen: the Product gets one Variant.
variants.removeDescription: The Variant is removed for good. Variants on Orders can't be removed.
variants.emptyDescription: Pick Attribute values above and generate the Variants.
variants.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Variants appear here once an Operations User generates them.
variants.unsaved: You have unsaved changes to the Variants.

categories.description: Group Products in two levels: top-level Categories and the Categories under them.
categories.formDescription: A Category can sit under a top-level Category, never under another child.
categories.deleteDescription: The Category is removed for good. Categories with children or Products can't be deleted.
categories.parentHint: Leave it as none to make this a top-level Category.
categories.parentLocked: {{name}} has child Categories, so it stays top-level.
categories.emptyDescription: Create the first Category to start organising the catalog.
categories.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Categories appear here once an Operations User adds them.

brands.description: Who makes your Products. Products can be filtered and reported by Brand.
brands.formDescription: A name, a slug for links and, if you like, a logo.
brands.logoNotSaved: The Brand was saved, but its logo wasn't: {{reason}}
brands.deleteDescription: The Brand and its logo are removed for good. Brands used by Products can't be deleted.
brands.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. A square image looks best.
brands.emptyDescription: Add the Brands your Products come from.
brands.emptyDescriptionReadOnly: Brands appear here once an Operations User adds them.
